title: Arpeggiator
description: Turns chords into runs of single notes, one after the other, at a rate you choose (for example 1/16). It takes notes between a clip and an instrument and gives notes back.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the notes through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: rate
parameters.doc: The length of one step of the run. Also written "sync", like the tempo lock of the tremolo.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.doc: The order of the notes; random is a stable order from the seed.

parameters.name: octaves
parameters.doc: How many octaves the run climbs.

parameters.name: gate
parameters.doc: How much of each step the note sounds, in percent.
